name: infoboard-mobile
description: Info Board mobile app - capture anything from your phone

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init 'Info Board' com.infoboard.app --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
